description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Earth], [Damage Cap +10000], [Awoken Stalwart], [Last Stand], [Stoneskin: 100%] and [Do-or-Die] to the user

description.name: Awoken Stalwart
description.text: Earth abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Persistent Strike after using an Earth attack

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: KO
description.text: Automatically set when HP reaches 0, prevents from acting, counts towards Game Over, persists after battle

description.name: Stoneskin: 100%
description.text: Reduces damage taken to 0, up to an amount equal to 100% of the character's maximum HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: Do-or-Die
description.text: Removed if the character doesn't have any Stoneskin, grants [Instant Cast] and [Last Stand] when removed
